title: Parkio Daily for September 15, 2026
teaser: Cosmic Rewind plays September all day on the 21st; Hispanic Heritage Month kicks off today; water park passes return with February blackouts.

bignews.title: Cosmic Rewind to play September on repeat next week
bignews.body: EPCOT's coaster will run Earth Wind and Fire's September all day on September 21, marking the fourth year of the fan tradition. The usual six-song rotation returns September 22.

parkioInsight.text: September 21 tends to draw bigger crowds to World Celebration and longer Cosmic Rewind queues by mid-morning. Riding in the first hour or after 7pm often keeps waits under 45 minutes.

bignews.title: Hispanic and Latin Heritage Month begins today across Walt Disney World
bignews.body: Together We Are Magia runs September 15 through October 15 with cultural performances, food, and special character appearances across all four parks.

parkioInsight.text: World Showcase tends to see heavier foot traffic during heritage celebrations. Worth catching the cultural performances early or after 5pm when walkways are less congested.

bignews.title: Water park seasonal pass returns with February and March blackouts
bignews.body: The 2027 pass is valid through May 15 but blocks February 19–21 and March 20–28. Pricing starts at discounted rates and includes mini golf and equipment rental perks.

parkioInsight.text: Water parks tend to fill fastest during spring break windows in late March. Visiting weekdays in April or early May often means walk-on slides and open lounge chairs.

bignews.title: Supernova Sip available at Connections Eatery on September 21 only
bignews.body: The limited-time beverage ties to the Cosmic Rewind September celebration and will be served for one day at the World Celebration restaurant.

parkioInsight.text: Specialty drinks tied to single-day promotions tend to sell out by mid-afternoon. Stopping by Connections before noon usually means shorter lines and full stock.

topstories.title: Baymax character meet opens at Hollywood Studios alongside animation area
topstories.body: The Big Hero 6 character is now greeting guests near the new Magic of Disney Animation experience, which officially debuted September 14 with a 60-character photo event.

parkioInsight.text: New character meets tend to draw long lines in the first week. Meeting Baymax within the first two hours of park opening often keeps waits under 20 minutes.

topstories.title: Hurly-Burly Jazz Club signage installed at BoardWalk
topstories.body: New white-and-gold Drinks Here signage and additional lettering have been added to the facade as the venue nears completion at Disney's BoardWalk Inn.

parkioInsight.text: New dining and entertainment venues at BoardWalk tend to fill quickly on opening weekends. Booking reservations or arriving early on weeknights usually secures a table without long waits.

topstories.title: Annual Passholders get four more Good to Go Days in September
topstories.body: Walt Disney World has added September 16, 17, 23, and 24 to the list of dates when passholders may enter parks without advance reservations.

parkioInsight.text: Good to Go Days tend to see modest increases in passholder attendance. Arriving before rope drop or visiting after 6pm often avoids the mid-day surge at Magic Kingdom and EPCOT.

topstories.title: 55th anniversary pins featuring Mickey and park icons now on sale
topstories.body: New collector pins show Mickey and Minnie in front of Cinderella Castle, Spaceship Earth, Hollywood Tower, and the Tree of Life. The jumbo pin retails for 39.99 dollars.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition anniversary pins tend to sell out fastest at Emporium and World of Disney. Shopping within the first hour of park opening usually offers full selection.

topstories.title: 2027 EPCOT Festival of the Arts dates and offerings announced
topstories.body: The festival returns with visual, culinary, and performing arts from January through February 2027, presented by Disney Lorcana Trading Card Game.

parkioInsight.text: Festival of the Arts tends to draw lighter crowds on weekdays in late January. Visiting Tuesday through Thursday often means shorter waits for food studios and art exhibits.

topstories.title: Flower and Garden Festival returns March 10 through May 31, 2027
topstories.body: The spring celebration will feature character topiaries, outdoor kitchens, and live entertainment throughout EPCOT for the full 83-day run.

parkioInsight.text: Flower and Garden weekends tend to see heavier World Showcase foot traffic, especially near outdoor kitchens. Touring Future World attractions before 11am usually avoids spillover congestion.

topstories.title: Disneyland Paris opens booking for refurbished Sequoia Lodge rooms
topstories.body: Reservations are now available for arrivals starting February 19, 2027. Rooms celebrate nature themes inspired by Bambi, Pocahontas, and Brave.

parkioInsight.text: Newly refurbished resort rooms tend to book quickly for spring and summer dates. Reserving within the first two weeks of availability usually secures preferred room categories.

icymi.title: Crowned Athletics launches new Halloween apparel collections
icymi.body: The merchandise line features spooky-themed athletic wear now available at Disney parks and online.

icymi.title: Logo Mania collection brings colorful attraction-themed merchandise to parks
icymi.body: The six-design collection features apparel celebrating favorite Disney lands, attractions, and transportation across both coasts.

icymi.title: Monorail service disrupted by lightning strike, guests stranded nearly two hours
icymi.body: A weather-related shutdown left passengers aboard without movement for an extended period before evacuation protocols were completed.

icymi.title: Play Disney Parks app digital achievements end tomorrow
icymi.body: Guests who have collected in-app milestones have until September 16 to access their digital records before the feature is removed.

spotlight.title: Disney After Hours expands to more nights across 2027
spotlight.body: Separate-ticket evening events return with extended hours, low waits, and complimentary snacks at Magic Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom. New dates are now bookable for January through May.

parkioInsight.text: After Hours events typically offer walk-on waits for headliners like Seven Dwarfs and Flight of Passage. Booking mid-week dates in February or early May tends to mean even lighter attendance and more re-rides.
